title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 55 South Pioneer Boulevard in Springboro, Ohio, as the "Richard 'Dick' Chenault Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 55 South Pioneer Boulevard in Springboro, Ohio, as the "Richard 'Dick' Chenault Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Postal Service building in Springboro, Ohio, after Richard "Dick" Chenault.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 55 South Pioneer Boulevard in Springboro, Ohio, as the "Richard 'Dick' Chenault Post Office Building." It is an honorary name change only. The summary does not describe any other changes to the building, its services, or its operations.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 5, 2015.
